name: Gaoth Sellsword (Combat)
body:
Your aptitude for combat is matched only for your willingness to sell it.

Prerequisite(s): Gaoth, base attack bonus +5, Dexterity 13

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 morale bonus on Initiative checks and gains a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls with any weapon with “gaoth” in its name.
